Siam and Silom

Siam is the BTS knot. Silom is offices by day and a short walk to Lumphini and the MRT. Useful if you want air-con and connections, not sois.

RailSiam interchange; Sala Daeng to MRT Si Lom
UseMalls, ARL link at Phaya Thai, park walks
StayCentral, less character than Thonglor

Stay at Siam if you arrive on the Airport Rail Link and want one night before you pick a neighborhood. Stay at Silom if you have meetings or want Lumphini at dawn.

Common questions

Is Siam a good four-night base?
It works. You will spend more time in malls than in sois. Move to Thonglor or the river if you want evenings.
